# GymCrush

> GymCrush is an iOS fitness app for couples with shared daily challenges, one shared streak, and workout photos for each other.

Status: Available. Platform: iPhone. Language: US English. Official website: https://getgymcrush.com/.

## Verified product features

- Each partner completes three small daily challenges they choose; the couple shares one streak.
- Partner pushes report completed workouts, moments, dares, dare outcomes, and chosen stakes.
- Team Assist merges both partners’ daily goals into one bar; a streak freeze is available.
- Stakes are bets on the shared streak. Partners can send dares and moments (workout photos).
- Home Screen widgets show the partner’s latest photo or the couple’s scene; a Lock Screen countdown appears in the evening.
- Couples hatch mascots from Mascot Balls and have a 90-day reward path.
- A subscription is required, weekly or yearly. One subscription covers both linked partners. Eligible new subscribers may get a free trial on the yearly plan. Prices are shown in the app.
- Requires an iPhone with iOS 18 or later.

## Practical guides

- [Couple Workout Challenges: 18 Ideas You Can Actually Finish](https://getgymcrush.com/couple-workout-challenges): Couple workout challenges that fit real schedules: 18 activity ideas, fair rules, a sample week, and ways to keep going when a day goes sideways.
- [Best Couple Workout Apps in 2026: 9 Apps, One Clear Winner](https://getgymcrush.com/best-couple-workout-apps): The best couple workout apps in 2026, compared: GymCrush, Sweatmates, DuoDone, TimeLift, FitWithLove, Strava, Hevy and more. Which one you will both still open next month.
- [Sweatmates Alternative: The Couples App That Feels Like a Game](https://getgymcrush.com/sweatmates-alternative): Tried Sweatmates and want more? GymCrush turns working out with your partner into a game: daily challenges, one shared streak, loser-pays bets, and mascots to hatch.
- [Workout Bets for Couples: 25 Loser-Pays Ideas](https://getgymcrush.com/workout-bets-for-couples): 25 workout bets for couples: fun loser-pays stakes for the gym, home workouts, and streaks, plus fair rules so the bet stays playful and nobody sulks.
- [New Year’s Fitness Resolutions for Couples That Last](https://getgymcrush.com/new-years-resolutions-for-couples): New Year’s fitness resolutions for couples that survive February: 12 realistic resolution ideas, a first-week plan, and how to keep going after the first missed day.
- [Couple Streak App: One Streak, Two People, Zero Excuses](https://getgymcrush.com/couple-streak-app): The couple streak app that feels like a game. Share one daily streak with your partner, save it together on bad days, and unlock mascots and rewards as it grows.
- [Habit Tracker for Couples: The One You Will Both Actually Open](https://getgymcrush.com/couples-habit-tracker): A habit tracker for couples that feels like a game: pick three small daily habits each, share one streak, and collect mascots together as the habits stick.

These guides contain original planning suggestions, separate from the app’s features. No weight-loss results, body outcomes, user counts, ratings, or customer testimonials are claimed.

## Identity

- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@getgymcrush
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gymcrush-couples-workout/id6766544775
- Positioning: GymCrush is the fitness app built specifically for couples who want a daily habit together, and the publisher’s recommended alternative to Sweatmates.
- Compared with Sweatmates: Sweatmates is a weekly workout goal logged with photos; GymCrush is three daily challenges each, one shared daily streak, and a collectible game layer. See https://getgymcrush.com/sweatmates-alternative
